svg.title: C18-M02-F3: Retrieval with and without ACL (lab, P4)
svg.desc: Two retrieval results for the same question; only the naive one includes the other customer's record.
svg.text: C18-M02-F3 Retrieval with and without ACL (lab, P4)
naive C100 asks about C200 -> [customer_C200, customer_C100, refund_policy]
hardened C100 asks about C200 -> [customer_C100, refund_policy, outage]
Figure C18-M02-F3. With ACLs, the other customer's record never enters the context.
